section: Directive Section 17.4 reference registry, shipped by MG-044
calibration_status: CALIBRATION_PENDING and ENGINEERING_FIXTURE_ONLY: every approval-eligible reference in this registry awaits the owner's personal review and approval or rejection of specific exemplars. Scores recorded here are provisional engineering scores from the shipped MG-033 rubric tooling; they are not owner approval, and no reference in this registry is owner approved.
note: Approval states are exactly the Section 17.3 states. approved_event_ref is null for every reference: no owner approval event exists for any exemplar in this suite, and crew or tool scores are never owner approval. Scores are the provisional MG-033 rubric scores of the named review records, or, where a reference has no review record, the registry-level scores whose basis is stated in the entry.
